name: Shimosuwa (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Shimosuwa town emblem in red: an outlined ring with a vertical stroke at the top, enclosing a ring.
history: Municipal flag of Shimosuwa, a town in Nagano Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 22 March 1948.

features.role: Shimosuwa town emblem — an outlined ring with a vertical stroke at the top, enclosing a ring
